doctorProfiles.name: Dr. David Okonkwo, MD, MBA
doctorProfiles.specialty: Adult & Pediatric Neurologist · Board-Certified in Neurology
doctorProfiles.bio: For more than 15 years, Dr. Okonkwo has practiced across hospital, outpatient, and telehealth settings, including time in physician leadership roles. What he brings to a consultation is patience: he takes the time to unpack complex medical information until it actually makes sense, rather than rushing through it. Patients across a wide range of ages and life stages have been under his care, which shows in how he listens before he advises.

doctorProfiles.name: Dr. Zachary B. Kramer, MD
doctorProfiles.bio: 15+ years in emergency medicine to help you sound decisions with clarity about weight management. He's always direct and clear about what a treatment can and can't do.

doctorProfiles.name: Dr. Gaurav K. Patel, MD
doctorProfiles.bio: Dr. Gaurav K. Patel brings 7+ years of experience across family medicine, hospital medicine, urgent care, telemedicine, and obesity medicine. His practical approach is valued by our team and patients.

doctorProfiles.name: Dr. Johnathan Chance Miller, MD
doctorProfiles.specialty: General Practice Physician · Telehealth Medical Evaluations
doctorProfiles.bio: Dr. Miller has spent 8+ years conducting medical evaluations entirely through telehealth, licensed across dozens of states along the way. He treats a screen the same way he'd treat an exam room.
